summary: Payday entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Payday 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC build with DLC/mod state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with documented DLC state

primary.version: Current Steam PC build with documented DLC/mod state
primary.why: Payday 2 is a long-running co-op game whose PC version has the broadest support, content, patch history, and capture/control options. Console and Switch routes lag or differ in content, so PC is the best archive target if DLC and online state are documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC build. Record build/date, owned DLC or collection, heists played, bot/solo/co-op state, mods, matchmaking/server state, difficulty, and account progression assumptions.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console access routes with different update/content history
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console-specific availability.
secondary.why: The PC route is the most complete and current archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC ownership, build date, mods, online/co-op state, and progression assumptions.

entries.title: Payday: The Heist
entries.definitive_edition: Steam PC release with Wolf Pack DLC and No Mercy state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release with DLC and co-op state documented

primary.version: Current Steam release with Wolf Pack DLC state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the best route for the original Payday, with higher capture flexibility and the current Steam ecosystem. The Wolf Pack DLC and free No Mercy heist affect completeness, so archive runs should record DLC ownership and online/co-op state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam PC build. Record build/date, DLC ownership, heist list, difficulty, crew/AI state, progression/reputation, matchmaking/server state, mods, and whether the PS3 route was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for PS3 performance, controls, or online-service history.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture and current access route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC and online state; do not substitute Payday 2 for the original game's heists/progression.
